_doc: Shared kit dimensions in metres (KIT_SPEC.md §3). Read by blender/build_kit.py and imported by src/generator.ts / src/roof.ts. Change sizes here only.

dormer._atelier: the atelier dormer: a glass wall over most of the bay between stone piers under a lintel, its own zinc roof running back to the top of the slope; heights above the cornice top
dormer._studio: the studio dormer: a French window of glass nearly to the cornice between stone piers, under a zinc roof that slopes down to the front and reaches out over it

street._doc: Sidewalk and street trees (src/streetlife.ts), in metres. width: sidewalk depth from the facade; top: height of the paving; curb / curbRise: width of the granite kerb at the edge and how far it stands above the paving; gutter: width of the cobbled gutter outside it; tree.offset: trunk distance from the facade as a share of the width; tree.count: trees along each street facade by default; tree.scale: the trees are modelled 1.9 m tall and scaled by this; tree.clear: no trunk this close to the front door; tree.grate / tree.ring: radius of the iron tree grille and the width of the cobbles round it.

interior._doc: Floor plans and interior volumes (INTERIOR_SPEC.md). floor: finished floor above an upper floor line; groundFloor: 1F floor above the street; ceiling: below the next floor line; atticCeiling: below the top of the steep slope; atticLining: how far (horizontally) the attic's sloping inner face sits inside the zinc. corridor and bands are between wall centre lines; bands.double / bands.core: interior depth from which a corridor / a central zone with a second corridor appear. doors: [width, height].

stair._doc: landing: where doors may open on a cage's side walls, from its front (wall centre line); the flights wind round a well whose far end is a half circle. depth: of a cage (wall centre lines), what the main stair takes / the least a service stair takes; main.minDepth: the main cage may be this short to leave a room beside it; maxDepth: beyond it a room is split off behind. riser / going: limits per step (going measured on the walking line, walkOffset from the well's edge); flight: width range, the narrower when the cage is short. soffit: thickness under the steps; rail: handrail height.

diningFurniture._doc: Rear-right 2F dining sample. Metres; cabinet at y=0, table long axis x.

salonFurniture._doc: Salon furniture on all floors. Metres, x along fireplace wall, +y into room. Sizes include placement envelopes.

bedroomFurniture._doc: Bedroom furniture in metres; local x across the bed, +y from head to foot. largeBedroomArea is clear floor area in square metres for the sage-green wall finish.
